I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/mruby`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A null pointer dereference in the bigint comparison path: cmpnum (src/numeric.c) can end up invoking mrb_bint_cmp which calls mpz_cmp (mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c) with an invalid/non-bigint operand, causing mpz_cmp to dereference a NULL/invalid pointer and trigger a segmentation fault. This leads to crashes (denial of service) during numeric comparisons.
